title: Kanban: flow, work-in-progress limits and cycle time

videos.script: Look at a board on a busy morning. Every column is full, and everybody is busy. {{board}} Now follow one card. It was worked on for two days, and it waited for five. {{card}} That waiting is where the time goes, and Kanban is a method for seeing it. {{kanban}} It asks for very little at the start. Put the work on a board. Then write a limit on each column. {{limits}} When a column is full, nobody starts anything new there. You help finish what is already in it. {{finish}} This lesson reads the Agenda team's board, then sets up the spreadsheet you will use for the rest of the course. {{workbook}} With it, you compute two numbers from dates the board already records: how long an item takes, and how many finish each week. {{numbers}}
